theorem: One positive pulse in each of the four projective null directions is a closed four-edge loop after reduction mod 3. Summing its 27 translates uses every one of the 108 null-history edges exactly once with orientation, and the resulting chain is exactly the previously certified unique PSp-invariant orientation cycle. It is also exactly the boundary of the sum of all 36 temporal triangles. Therefore the integer-cover common winding maps canonically to the orientation cycle but dies in filled temporal H1 and hence in its injective global-W33 H1 image.
